Like every other reference type's `genre` field, this is normalized to a kebab-case canonical key by `Reference::genre()` and re-expanded for display by `Locale::lookup_genre()` — internal capitalization or punctuation beyond simple words will not round-trip exactly (e.g. an acronym loses its casing). Used as the `type-label` component's fallback text when no title is present, taking precedence over the locale's generic "dataset" term. |
| `format` | string |  | File format. Prefer IANA media types (e.g., `"text/csv"`) or common abbreviations (e.g., `"NetCDF"`, `"HDF5"`) where no IANA type exists. |
| `size` | string |  | Dataset size (e.g., "2.4 GB", "150,000 records") |

| `version` | string |  | Version number (e.g., "4.1.0", "v2.3.1") |
| `repository` | string |  | Repository URL |
| `license` | string |  | SPDX license identifier preferred (e.g., `"MIT"`, `"GPL-3.0-only"`, `"Apache-2.0"`). See <https://spdx.org/licenses/> for the authoritative identifier list. |
| `platform` | string |  | Platform (e.g., "Windows", "macOS", "Linux", "cross-platform") |
| `doi` | string |  | DOI identifier. |
| `url` | string |  | URL for the software. |
| `accessed` | DateValue |  | Date the URL was accessed. |
| `language` | LangID |  | BCP 47 language of the software documentation. |
| `field-languages` | map<string, LangID> |  | Per-field language overrides. |
| `note` | RichText |  | Freeform note. |
| `keywords` | string[] |  | Keywords or subject tags. |
| `identifiers` | SupplementaryIdentifiers |  | Extensible standardized identifiers without dedicated Citum fields. |

## `event`

Event metadata for conferences, performances, broadcasts, and recordings.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | RefID |  | Unique identifier for this reference. |
| `title` | Title |  | Event name (e.g., conference title, performance name). |
| `container` | WorkRelation |  | Immediate container (e.g., broadcast program, proceedings volume). |
| `series` | WorkRelation |  | Recurring event series (e.g., annual conference series). |
| `original` | WorkRelation |  | Original work or publication from which this event derives. |
| `location` | string |  | Event location (city, venue). |
| `date` | DateValue |  | Event date. |
| `available-date` | DateValue |  | Date the event became or will become publicly available. |
| `genre` | string |  | Event genre (e.g., `"conference"`, `"performance"`, `"broadcast"`, `"talk"`). |
| `network` | string |  | Broadcaster, network, or streaming platform. |
| `contributors` | ContributorEntry[] |  | Unified contributor list with explicit role tags. |
| `url` | string |  | URL for the event. |
| `accessed` | DateValue |  | Date the URL was accessed. |
| `language` | LangID |  | BCP 47 language of the event. |
| `field-languages` | map<string, LangID> |  | Per-field language overrides. |
| `note` | RichText |  | Freeform note. |
| `identifiers` | SupplementaryIdentifiers |  | Extensible standardized identifiers without dedicated Citum fields. |

## `audio-visual`

An audio-visual work: film, TV episode, recording, or broadcast.

This is a work-like reference class. It represents the creative work
when that work is the citee, not a fully modeled release hierarchy.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | RefID |  | Unique identifier for a reference item. |
| `type` | AudioVisualType |  | Discriminates audio-visual subtypes for style-directed formatting. |
| `title` | Title |  | A title can be a single string, a structured title, or a multilingual title. |
| `short-title` | string |  | — |
| `contributors` | ContributorEntry[] |  | A single entry in a reference's contributors list. |
| `created` | DateValue |  | — |
| `issued` | DateValue |  | — |
| `original` | WorkRelation |  | A relation to another bibliographic entity. |
| `language` | LangID |  | BCP 47 language tag (e.g., `"en"`, `"de"`, `"ja"`). |
| `genre` | string |  | — |
| `container` | WorkRelation |  | A relation to another bibliographic entity. |
| `event` | WorkRelation |  | A relation to another bibliographic entity. |
| `numbering` | Numbering[] |  | A numbering identifier for a work (e.g., volume, issue, number). |
| `number` | string |  | Catalog or episode number shorthand (normalized into `numbering`). |
| `publisher` | Publisher |  | A publisher or production company. |
| `medium` | string |  | — |
| `dimensions` | string |  | — |
| `platform` | string |  | — |
| `url` | string |  | — |
| `accessed` | DateValue |  | — |
| `field-languages` | map<string, LangID> |  | — |
| `note` | RichText |  | Inline markup for freeform text fields (note, abstract). |
| `identifiers` | SupplementaryIdentifiers |  | Extensible standardized identifiers without dedicated Citum fields. |

## Closed Vocabularies

### AudioVisualType

Discriminates audio-visual subtypes for style-directed formatting.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `film` | A film or motion picture (default). |
| `episode` | A single episode of a TV series, podcast, or web series. |
| `recording` | A recording (music video, concert, etc.). |
| `broadcast` | A broadcast program. |

### CollectionType

Discriminates collection subtypes for style-directed formatting.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `anthology` | A curated anthology of independent works (e.g., short stories, essays). |
| `proceedings` | Published proceedings of a conference or symposium. |
| `edited-book` | A book assembled from contributions by multiple authors under an editor. |
| `edited-volume` | An edited volume that may span multiple books or a series. |

### MonographComponentType

Discriminates monograph-component subtypes for style-directed formatting.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `chapter` | A chapter within a book or edited volume. |
| `document` | A document component that does not fit a more specific subtype. |

### MonographType

Discriminates monograph subtypes for style-directed formatting.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `book` | A book or monograph (default). |
| `manual` | A technical manual or user guide. |
| `report` | A technical or institutional report. |
| `thesis` | An academic thesis or dissertation. |
| `webpage` | A webpage or standalone web document. |
| `post` | A standalone post (e.g., social media, forum). |
| `interview` | An interview treated as a standalone monographic source. |
| `manuscript` | An unpublished manuscript or archival document. |
| `preprint` | A preprint hosted on a preprint server (arXiv, bioRxiv, SSRN, etc.). |
| `personal-communication` | A letter, email, or other personal communication. |
| `document` | A generic standalone document that does not fit a more specific subtype. |

### SerialComponentType

Discriminates serial-component subtypes for style-directed formatting.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `article` | A peer-reviewed or editorial article in a journal, magazine, or newspaper. |
| `post` | A post within an online serial (blog, news site, social feed). |
| `review` | A review published in a serial (book review, film review, etc.). |

### SerialType

Types of serial publications.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `academic-journal` | An academic peer-reviewed journal. |
| `blog` | A blog or personal website updated periodically. |
| `magazine` | A general-interest magazine. |
| `newspaper` | A newspaper. |
| `newsletter` | A newsletter. |
| `proceedings` | A conference proceedings serial. |
| `podcast` | A podcast. |
| `broadcast-program` | A broadcast program (radio, television). |
